run_metadata.coverage_summary: All source tiers were attempted (Tier 1 Commonwealth + all states/territories; Tier 2 councils/GBEs/universities/health; Tier 3 private-sector e-sourcing hubs and major-buyer portals; plus a dedicated source-discovery sweep). Connectivity was re-tested at the start of the run exactly as on prior days: WebFetch to the Tier 1 control host www.tenders.gov.au returned EGRESS_BLOCKED, and a direct curl to www.tenders.gov.au returned 'CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403'. The agent-proxy status endpoint reports enabled=true, selective=false, bundleCoversEveryHost=true, recentRelayFailures empty, yet every external CONNECT is rejected (only infrastructure hosts in noProxy - Anthropic API, npm/PyPI/crates/go package registries - are reachable). The proxy README confirms a 403/407 from the proxy is an organisation egress-policy denial that must be reported and must NOT be retried or routed around. This is the SAME session-wide deny-by-default egress block seen on the 2026-09-30 through 2026-10-07 runs - now NINE consecutive days. WebSearch still works (it routes through the Anthropic API, not the egress proxy) and was used for a source-discovery sweep across Tiers 1-3. Because the spec's fidelity rule requires every tender detail to be taken from the actual notice or its documents, and no notice or tender-detail page could be opened or verified, NO opportunity could be confirmed - so this run records ZERO tenders rather than repeating unverified aggregator/search snippets. The source-discovery sweep surfaced nine buyer-originated procurement sources not present in any prior run (Livingstone Shire Council QLD; Woollahra Municipal Council NSW; Hay Shire Council NSW; City of South Perth WA; University of South Australia; CQUniversity; University of Southern Queensland; Ballarat Health Services VIC; PanAust mining); all are recorded in discovered_sources with a clear note that they were surfaced via WebSearch and could NOT be fetch-verified this run due to the egress block. No tenders, deliverables, dates, contacts, or corporate opportunities were invented.
gaps: Session-wide organisation egress block (9th consecutive day, 2026-09-30 to 2026-10-08): WebFetch returns EGRESS_BLOCKED and direct curl returns 'CONNECT tunnel failed, response 403' for every external host. Only noProxy infrastructure hosts (Anthropic API, npm/PyPI/crates/go registries) are reachable.
Tier 1 (AusTender + all 8 state/territory portals): could NOT be fetched or verified - every detail page and feed/API is behind the egress block. No opportunities confirmed.
Tier 2 (councils/VendorPanel, GBEs, water corps, universities, health): could NOT be fetched or verified. Candidate sources were only surfaced via WebSearch snippets.

Tier 3 (SAP Ariba Discovery, Coupa, major-buyer portals BHP/Rio/Woodside/Woolworths/Coles/Qantas/banks/telcos): could NOT be fetched or verified. Ariba Discovery and all corporate portals are unreachable; no publicly-advertised corporate RFx could be confirmed, so none recorded as tenders (per spec, gated/invitation-only corporate RFx are not invented).
WebSearch returns titles/snippets only and cannot substitute for opening the buyer's own notice; per the fidelity rule, snippet-only data is not treated as a confirmed opportunity.
New sources below were discovered via WebSearch only and are NOT fetch-verified this run; confidence is set accordingly and they should be re-verified once egress is restored.
